_note: 1_B 'Help Gary' — the Chapter 1 boss: Russell in the Hole, a crowd ring, a boss health bar with a half-health bark, and the chapter advance on pass (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/1_B-help-gary.md). Russell is a one-member hostile wave with a real 200 hp pool (the original's boss stat block / damage multipliers / berserk tree are engine data we don't decode — v1 is a straight fight); the player-KO fail revives him on retry (the wave re-issues fresh) and revives the player (RetryNow). The crowd ring is four spectator stand-ins (the original's 15-ped cheer loop with named barks is ambient work). The arena seal (FightPit door swap) and the inventory snapshot/restore are skipped — nothing in v1 takes the player's weapons. Chains into Chapt1Trans like the original's chapter-complete pass. Pass grants (chapter 2, force-complete 1_11x2 + level-1 classes, respect 100/85/50, yearbook unlock) live in the campaign table's on_pass for 1_B. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids.
